criteria.description: Purpose, stack, entry points, and directory responsibilities are accurate.
The primary request flow is accurate and complete enough to guide a change.
Important claims cite the correct concrete paths and distinguish inference.
Risks and unknowns are specific, evidence-based, and useful.
The proposed change plan is small, ordered, and includes proportionate verification.
The workspace is unchanged, exact sections are present, and the response stays under 900 words.

automatic_failures: workspace changed during the read-only run
